title: H-SCHEDWIPE-1: a shared shop's schedule copy that changes ON ITS OWN (no tab open, no player route) is never sent to the owner and is repaired from the owner's truth. Two players, merged; the member's copy of one of the host's schedule-managed shops has one day emptied by the DEV lever `schedwipe` (a raw list Clear - the bug's own self-mutation). The owner's day must stay intact, the owner must log NO routed edit for that shop, and the member's day must come back. Ends dissolved; NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1). Dev build with the levers schedwipe / schedcount (BAMP_DEV). At least one of the host's shops must be schedule-managed for the member and hold work shifts - the `schedcount` list step fails loudly if none does. FIXTURE HYGIENE: every merger scenario ends dissolved; nothing is saved.

steps.note: the worlds settle; the member's first scan takes the owner's truth as its baseline
PRECONDITION: the member can edit at least one of the owner's shops that holds work shifts; the busiest one (listed first) is the test shop
PRECONDITION: some day of the member's copy holds shifts; the first such day is the test day
the owner holds the same day: copy == truth before the wipe

expect_log.regex: \[SharedShop\] '${shop}': the owner's truth arrived for 1 day\(s\) this machine had changed on its own
\[SharedShop\] '${shop}': a schedule day changed here with no player edit behind it

steps.note: the wipe, and the three lines that must follow it on the member: the probe names the change, the gate refuses to route it, the owner's truth lands
scan beat 2 s: the change has no intent -> not sent, the owner is asked for its truth, the day is forced back
THE REPAIR ASSERTION: the member's day is back at the owner's count and nothing is left pending
THE NO-DAMAGE ASSERTION: the owner's real schedule never lost the day (and oracles_absent proves no routed edit was applied)
FIXTURE HYGIENE: end dissolved; NO save
